evidence: The film crystallinity was evaluated by X-ray diffraction (XRD) and thickness by X-ray reflectance (XRR) measurements using a Bruker D8 Advance X-ray diffractometer. The thickness and refractive indexes of thick reference films on glass were determined by fitting the optical transmission spectra obtained using a Hitachi U2000 spectrophotometer. The composition was determined by time-of-flight elastic recoil detection analysis (TOF-ERDA). Dielectric properties of Al/metal-oxide/n-Si/Al capacitors were measured at room temperature. Capacitance–voltage (C–V) curves were measured using a HP 4284 A precision LCR-meter in two-element series mode. The current–voltage curves were recorded with a Keithley 2400 Source Meter in the stair sweep voltage mode.
